market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely volatile in 1-3 month window. Fed hawkishness and oil-driven disinflation create mixed signals. Nasdaq may extend rally on AI momentum but correction risk rising. Expect 5-10% pullback in overvalued growth names. Gold and Treasuries remain bid. Turkey contagion could trigger EM selloff. Earnings season will test corporate guidance.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook moderately constructive. Oil normalization supports margin expansion. AI capex cycle continues but selective. GLP-1 drugs drive healthcare leadership. Crypto regulatory clarity unlocks institutional flows. Geopolitical risks (Russia-NATO, Venezuela) create episodic volatility. Consumer squeeze persists through 2027. Fed likely peaks rates by Q1 2027, enabling equity re-rating.
